cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Could you phone Mum and begin the conversation about selling the house?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked to speak to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll take over once you've said the word selling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put her on speaker. You'll be there for the whole thing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's fine. Introduce the idea, and when she says my full name, I'll answer.

mechanism: A uses specialist briefing and correction to assign someone else the emotionally difficult opening.
confusable: Ordinary delegation differs from keeping the first painful sentence with B while A claims competent supporting duties.
comparison: Public cancellation uses organizational expertise; a family house call uses coaching of the opening words.
seedUse: Use choir refunds and a house conversation as distinct pressures; do not borrow the protected hamster mechanism.
